p4_b7.ocr: HRQOL of different disease distribution Eighty-nine, 87, and 48 patients with UC had proctitis, left-sided colitis, and extensive colitis, respectively. The median IBDQ total scores for patients with proctitis, left-sided colitis, and ex- tensive colitis were 152.00, 154.00, and 160.50, respectively (Table 7). The differences in disease distribution were not statistically significant with respect to the IBDQ total score (P = 0.183) and four domains (P>0.05).
